# Wantek

> Wantek is a professional headset manufacturer offering wireless, Bluetooth, USB, and wired solutions for office, gaming, call centers, and emergency services.

Wantek specializes in noise-cancelling headsets across multiple product lines including Wantek®, Voistek®, Greyolk®, and Kimhost® brands. The site serves remote workers, gamers, call center professionals, and emergency dispatch teams with advanced audio technology.

## Key Topics

- Wantek® headsets
- Noise-cancelling technology
- Wireless Bluetooth headsets
- USB Type-C headphones
- RJ9 connector headsets
- Call center headsets
- Gaming headsets
- Office/remote work headsets
- Voistek® wireless headsets
- Greyolk® AI noise cancellation
- Kimhost® bone conduction
- Bluetooth 5.3
- IP68 waterproof
- Professional audio
- Emergency dispatch headsets

## Brand Collections

- [Wantek Headset Collection](https://www.iwantek.com/collections/wantek%C2%AE-headset): Wantek headset product collection with noise-canceling mics for remote work.
- [Voistek® Wireless Headsets](https://www.iwantek.com/collections/viostek%C2%AE-headset): Voistek wireless headsets with noise-cancelling mics and 40-50 hour battery life.
- [Greyolk Premium Headsets](https://www.iwantek.com/collections/greyolk%C2%AE-headset): Greyolk premium wireless headsets with AI noise cancellation and bone conduction.
- [Kimhost Wireless Headsets](https://www.iwantek.com/collections/kimhost%C2%AE-headset): Kimhost wireless headsets with Bluetooth 5.3, bone conduction, and IP68 waterproof.

## Product Categories

- [Wireless Headsets & Headphones](https://www.iwantek.com/collections/wireless-headset): Premium wireless headphones with Bluetooth and noise-cancelling for work and gaming.
- [Noise Cancelling Office Headsets](https://www.iwantek.com/collections/noise-cancelling-headset-for-office): Professional noise-cancelling headsets for open offices and hybrid work environments.
- [Gaming Headsets with Microphone](https://www.iwantek.com/collections/headsets-for-gamming): Gaming headsets with noise-canceling mics for immersive, high-fidelity sound.
- [Call Center Headsets](https://www.iwantek.com/collections/headset-for-call-center): Professional call center headsets with advanced noise-canceling and durability.
- [PC Headsets & Microphones](https://www.iwantek.com/collections/pc-headset): PC headsets and microphones for gaming, work, and streaming applications.
- [USB Type-C Headphones](https://www.iwantek.com/collections/usb-headsets): USB Type-C headphones with advanced DAC for Samsung, Google Pixel, and iPad.
- [Wired Office Phone Headsets](https://www.iwantek.com/collections/wired-headset-for-dect-phone): Wired headsets for office phones with RJ9 connectors and noise-canceling mics.
- [Emergency Dispatch Headsets](https://www.iwantek.com/collections/headsets-for-911): Specialized 911 dispatch headsets with RJ9 connectors for emergency services.
